production.direction_en: At the altar's outer ring, the returned companions raise wards and open an evacuation path. The five-person core party faces the last sentinels while distant friends hold the side lanes in a non-playable set piece.
production.music_direction_en: pre: bgm_held_the_road → bgm_tension | post: sting_bell_toll (the pulse stops)

commands.speaker: sable_wren
commands.text: The east passage is clear. I left a lantern at every turn; nobody gets lost in the dark tonight.

commands.speaker: vespera_wisp
commands.text: The altar is counting backward. It has mistaken a bell for a clock.

commands.speaker: tilda_fen
commands.text: The eastern anchor is mine. Hana, take the evacuees through the lantern path.

commands.speaker: hana_birch
commands.text: I will. And Fadyme—I kept my promise. Come back, so I can stop keeping it.

commands.speaker: mahmut
commands.text: You do not have to promise alone.
